domains.http://$: Template literal inside a URL-normalising helper (`http://${host}`), not a literal request.
domains.http://docs.oasis-open.org: ODF/OpenDocument XML namespace and relation-type URIs read from .ods/.fods files.
domains.http://example.com: Placeholder base used by a URL parser when no base is supplied; never fetched.
domains.http://localhost:3000: npm `scripts` metadata from the bundled tesseract.js package.json, shown only if printed.
domains.http://macVmlSchemaUri: Key of SheetJS's VML namespace table (an object key, not a URL).
domains.http://ns.adobe.com: XMP/XFA namespace and element names in PDF documents (pdf.js constants).
domains.http://openoffice.org: OpenOffice XML namespace URIs in ODF files.
domains.http://schemas.openxmlformats.org: OOXML namespace and relationship-type URIs — the bulk of .docx/.xlsx/.pptx parsing.
domains.http://stuartk.com: Property name in SheetJS's format table (`stuartk.com` comment/format id).
domains.http://www.apache.org: Apache-licensed PDF font/licence identifier string in pdf.js.
domains.http://www.w3.org: W3C XML/HTML/SVG/XLink namespace URIs, including the inline SVG data URI in index.html.
domains.http://www.xfa.org: XFA namespace in PDF forms (pdf.js constants).
domains.https://cdn.jsdelivr.net: tesseract.js's *default* workerPath/corePath/langPath. Every one is overridden in src/pipeline/extract/image.ts with a same-origin /tess or /tessdata path, so no request can reach jsDelivr.
domains.https://foo.bar: Base URL in a try/catch URL-parse helper; a parser input, never fetched.
domains.https://github.com: Issue/discussion links inside bundled error messages and package metadata.
domains.https://opencollective.com: `opencollective-postinstall` message text from tesseract.js; only runs at npm install.
domains.https://raw.github.com: Repository link in bundled package metadata.
domains.https://rolldown.rs: Bundler error-message link for CommonJS interop.
domains.https://row-data-converter.vercel.app: This site's own canonical/og:image URLs in index.html — a self-reference, not a third party.
domains.https://stuk.github.io: JSZip error-message link explaining a corrupt archive.
domains.https://tailwindcss.com: Tailwind licence comment in the built CSS.

callReasons.assets/index.js: One fetch: the service-worker update check / asset list read, same origin only (CSP connect-src 'self').
callReasons.assets/pdf.worker.min.mjs: pdf.js loads its cMap and standard-font files with fetch/XHR; the app only ever passes same-origin /assets paths, and CSP connect-src 'self' blocks anything else.
callReasons.assets/pipeline.worker.js: tesseract.js and pdf.js inside the conversion worker: same-origin reads of /tessdata and the PDF CMaps. The app overrides every library default URL with an origin-relative path.
callReasons.tess/tesseract-core-lstm.wasm.js: Emscripten's wasm loader fetching its sibling binary; only same-origin paths are passed by tesseract.js.
